sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: A
thai: สวัสดีครับ ไม่ได้เจอกันตั้งนานครับ
phonetic: sà-wàt-dii-khráp mâi-dâi-joe-kan-tâng-naan khráp
english: Hello, long time no see.
translation: Hello, long time no see.

sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: B
thai: สวัสดีค่ะ ดีใจที่ได้เจอค่ะ
phonetic: sà-wàt-dii khâ dii-jai-thîi-dâi-jooe khâ
english: Hello, nice to see you.
translation: Hello, nice to see you.

sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: A
thai: ช่วงนี้คุณเป็นยังไงบ้างครับ
phonetic: chûang-níi khun bpen-yang-ngai-bâang khráp
english: How have you been these days?
translation: How have you been these days?

sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: B
thai: ตอนนี้ฉันเลี้ยงดูลูกสาวค่ะ
phonetic: dtaawn-níi chǎn líiang-duu lûuk-sǎao khâ
english: These days I'm raising my daughter.
translation: These days I'm raising my daughter.

sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: A
thai: ยุ่งมากเลยใช่ไหมครับ
phonetic: yûng mâak loei châi mǎi khráp
english: You must be really busy, right?
translation: You must be really busy, right?

sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: B
thai: ใช่ค่ะ มีเวลาว่างแค่นิดหน่อยค่ะ
phonetic: châi khâ mii wee-laa-wâang khâe-nít-nòi khâ
english: Yes, I only have a little free time.
translation: Yes, I only have a little free time.

sceneTitle: A coffee shop in Bangkok, two friends meeting after a long time
speaker: A
thai: งั้นผมซื้อกาแฟกระป๋องไว้ครับ
phonetic: ngán phǒm súue gaa-fae grà-bpǎwng wái khráp
english: So I bought canned coffee in advance.
translation: So I bought canned coffee in advance.

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: B
thai: อ้อเมื่อวานฉันไปงานแต่งงานเพื่อนค่ะ
phonetic: ôo mûea-waan chǎn pai ngaan-dtàeng-ngaan phûean khâ
english: Oh, yesterday I went to a friend's wedding.
translation: Oh, yesterday I went to a friend's wedding.

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: A
thai: เหรอครับ วันนี้ว่างไหมครับ
phonetic: roe khráp wan-níi wâang mǎi khráp
english: Really? Are you free today?
translation: Really? Are you free today?

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: B
thai: วันนี้ไม่มีนัดค่ะ
phonetic: wan-níi mâi-mii nát khâ
english: I have no appointment today.
translation: I have no appointment today.

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: A
thai: งั้นไปที่ไหนดีครับ
phonetic: ngán pai-thîi-nǎi dii khráp
english: So where should we go?
translation: So where should we go?

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: B
thai: ตลาดค่ะ ฉันไปเสมอค่ะ
phonetic: dtà-làat khâ chǎn pai sà-mǒoe khâ
english: The market. I always go there.
translation: The market. I always go there.

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: A
thai: แผนนี้ดีครับ ไปเมื่อไหร่ดีครับ
phonetic: phaen níi dii khráp pai mûea-rài dii khráp
english: This plan is good. When shall we go?
translation: This plan is good. When shall we go?

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: B
thai: อีกยี่สิบเจ็ดนาทีค่ะ
phonetic: ìik yîi-sìp-jèt naa-thii khâ
english: In twenty-seven minutes.
translation: In twenty-seven minutes.

sceneTitle: at the meeting spot, before going to the market
speaker: A
thai: เมื่อถึงเวลาไปกันครับ
phonetic: mûea thǔeng wee-laa pai kan khráp
english: When it's time, let's go.
translation: When it's time, let's go.

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: B
thai: ถึงเวลาแล้วค่ะ นั่งรถเมล์ไปกันค่ะ
phonetic: thǔeng wee-laa lâeo khâ nâng rót-mee pai kan khâ
english: Time is up, let's go by bus.
translation: Time is up, let's go by bus.

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: A
thai: ดีครับ ไปรอที่ป้ายรถเมล์กันครับ
phonetic: dii khráp pai raw thîi bpâai-rót-mee kan khráp
english: Good, let's go and wait at the bus stop.
translation: Good, let's go and wait at the bus stop.

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: B
thai: เดินไปป้ายรถเมล์ไหวไหมคะ
phonetic: doen pai bpâai-rót-mee wǎi mǎi khá
english: Can you manage to walk to the bus stop?
translation: Can you manage to walk to the bus stop?

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: A
thai: ไหวครับ ใส่กางเกงขาสั้นสบายครับ
phonetic: wǎi khráp sài kaang-keeng-khǎa-sân sà-baai khráp
english: Yes, I can. Wearing shorts is comfortable.
translation: Yes, I can. Wearing shorts is comfortable.

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: B
thai: ดีค่ะ รถเมล์สิบบาท ฉันจ่ายให้ค่ะ
phonetic: dii khâ rót-mee sìp bàat chǎn jàai hâi khâ
english: Good. The bus is ten baht. I'll pay for you.
translation: Good. The bus is ten baht. I'll pay for you.

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: A
thai: ขอโทษนะครับ ผมลืมเงินครับ
phonetic: khǎw-thôot ná khráp phǒm luem ngoen khráp
english: Sorry, I forgot my money.
translation: Sorry, I forgot my money.

sceneTitle: bus stop, on the way to the market
speaker: B
thai: ไม่เป็นไรค่ะ ฉันให้อภัยคุณค่ะ
phonetic: mâi-bpen-rai khâ chǎn hâi-à-phai khun khâ
english: No problem. I forgive you.
translation: No problem. I forgive you.

sceneTitle: eating and drinking
speaker: B
thai: ถึงตลาดแล้วค่ะ เชิญนั่งค่ะ
phonetic: thǔeng dtà-làat lâeo khâ choen-nâng khâ
english: We've arrived at the market. Please sit.
translation: We've arrived at the market. Please sit.

sceneTitle: eating and drinking
speaker: A
thai: ผัดไทยหรือต้มยำกุ้งดีครับ
phonetic: phàt-thai rǔue tôm-yam-gûng dii khráp
english: Pad thai or tom yum goong, which is good?
translation: Pad thai or tom yum goong, which is good?

sceneTitle: eating and drinking
speaker: B
thai: ผัดไทยค่ะ ทุกคนชมว่าอร่อยค่ะ
phonetic: phàt-thai khâ thúk-khon chom wâa à-ròi khâ
english: Pad thai. Everyone praises it as delicious.
translation: Pad thai. Everyone praises it as delicious.

sceneTitle: eating and drinking
speaker: A
thai: ดีครับ ผมชอบผัดไทยตลอดไปครับ
phonetic: dii khráp phǒm châwp phàt-thai dtà-làawt-pai khráp
english: Good. I'll love pad thai forever.
translation: Good. I'll love pad thai forever.

sceneTitle: eating and drinking
speaker: B
thai: มาแล้วค่ะ ทานกันเลยค่ะ
phonetic: maa lâeo khâ thaan-kan-loei khâ
english: It's here. Let's eat!
translation: It's here. Let's eat!
